name: L-Arginine
summary: Health Canada adult oral supplement monograph includes cardiovascular precautions and a post-myocardial-infarction contraindication for products above 9 g/day; this is not a food-use safety limit.
context: Adult oral supplement products above 9 g/day; prior myocardial infarction

name: L-Phenylalanine
summary: Phenylketonuria requires restriction of phenylalanine; common nutrient status does not support an unrestricted benign label.

name: D-Fructose
summary: EMA guidance for fructose/sorbitol medicinal excipients flags hereditary fructose intolerance; dietary comparator population and dose need a separate assessment.

name: Lactose
summary: Lactose malabsorption can produce dose-dependent digestive symptoms; identify the comparator population and exact sugar form.

name: Sorbitol
summary: EMA guidance for fructose/sorbitol medicinal excipients flags hereditary fructose intolerance; dietary comparator population and dose need a separate assessment.

name: Sorbitol
summary: US food labeling provisions require a laxative warning at foreseeable daily ingestion of 50 g sorbitol; this is a labeling trigger, not a universal safe dose.

name: Mannitol
summary: US food labeling provisions require a laxative warning at foreseeable daily ingestion of 20 g mannitol; this is a labeling trigger, not a universal safe dose.

name: Xylitol
summary: FDA warns that xylitol is toxic to dogs; a human dietary use cannot be extended to other species.

name: Erythritol
summary: EFSA's 2023 food-additive reassessment set an ADI based on diarrhea; the value does not establish plant inactivity or unrestricted high-dose safety.
context: Human food-additive assessment; diarrhea and secondary effects

name: Caprylic acid
summary: EPA's registration-review product table lists caprylic/capric acids as herbicide active ingredients; exclude from a presumed plant-inactive comparison group.
